units.intent: A lively full-body hop on both accents, with the mitten-bearing upper body swishing side-to-side and the face nodding to echo the dancer's prominent arm and head motions.
Switch to sharper alternating side hits of the attached blue mittens, punctuated by compact soft-body compressions rather than leg movements.
Make each arm-led hit a gentler sideways upper-body swing, with small synchronized hops translating the dancer's footwork; land the close final pair distinctly.
